PNG压缩级别 (0-9)，值越高压缩率越高但速度越慢（无损压缩）: PNG compression level (0-9). Higher = better compression but slower (lossless)
ℹ️ 下载+嵌入模式：外部字幕文件将被保留。MP4 对字幕嵌入支持有限，MKV: ℹ️ Download + embed mode: external subtitle files are kept. MP4 has limited subtitle embedding support; MKV is more reliable
ℹ️ 仅嵌入模式：yt-dlp 会自动下载字幕并嵌入后删除外部文件: ℹ️ Embed-only mode: yt-dlp auto-downloads subtitles, embeds them, then deletes the external files
⚠ MP4 对字幕嵌入支持有限，MKV 更稳.建议在'高级格式'功能中选择 MK: ⚠ MP4 has limited subtitle embedding support; MKV is more reliable. Choose MKV in 'Advanced Format' if needed
一键清空所有下载历史记录（不可恢复）: Clear all download history in one click (cannot be undone)
下载完成后保留临时片段文件，用于调试（会占用额外空间）: Keep temporary fragment files after download for debugging (uses extra disk space)
下载完整的视频元数据信息并保存为.info.json文件，包含标题、作者、时长、: Download full video metadata and save as .info.json (title, author, duration, views, etc.)
下载平台自动生成的字幕（如YouTube自动字幕、Bilibili AI字幕等）: Download auto-generated subtitles (e.g. YouTube auto subs, Bilibili AI subs)
下载视频的描述信息并保存为.description文件: Download video description and save as .description file
下载视频评论并保存为JSON文件（如果网站支持）: Download video comments and save as JSON file (if supported)
仅对通用小模型 realesr-general-x4v3 有效，用于平衡降噪和细: Only applies to the general small model realesr-general-x4v3; balances denoising and detail retention.
从直播开始时间下载，而不是从当前时间开始（实验性功能）: Download from the start of the live stream instead of the current time (experimental)
会追加到输出文件名后面，用来区分原文件和修复结果。: Appended to the output filename to distinguish results from originals.
使用GPU硬件加速编码，可以大幅提高转码速度: Use GPU hardware acceleration for encoding to greatly speed up transcoding
使用视频URL中的时间参数（如果有）: Use the time parameter from the video URL (if any)
先把要修复的图片或视频加到这里，再开始批量处理。: Add images or videos to enhance here first, then start batch processing.
决定输出放大倍率。2 倍更快更稳，4 倍更清晰但更耗时。: Output upscale factor. 2x is faster and more stable; 4x is sharper but slower.
勾选后只下载指定时间段的视频内容，需要 ffmpeg: When checked, only download the specified time range (requires ffmpeg)
勾选后跳过不可用片段；不勾选时遇到缺失片段将中止下载: Skip unavailable fragments when checked; otherwise the download aborts on missing fragments
勾选后，如果目标文件已存在，会直接覆盖旧结果。: When checked, existing output files will be overwritten.
只有在你明确知道要调什么时再展开。默认设置已经适合大多数用户。: Only expand if you know what you're adjusting. Defaults suit most users.
可指定修复结果保存位置。留空时，输出到原文件所在目录。: Set where enhanced files are saved. Leave empty to save next to the originals.
可直接拖入图片或视频，也可以点击下方按钮手动添加。: Drag in images or videos directly, or use the buttons below to add them.
启动时自动检查软件与依赖更新: Check for app & dependency updates on startup
启用后使用 MIN-MAX 区间随机等待: Use a random MIN-MAX wait interval when enabled
启用更新提示音和弹窗: Play update notification sound and popup
启用此功能后，才能使用下方的特殊场景下载选项: Enable this to unlock the special-scenario download options below
启用网络代理，支持HTTP、HTTPS和SOCKS5代理: Enable network proxy (HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 supported)
图片质量 (1-100)，值越高质量越好文件越大: Image quality (1-100). Higher = better quality, larger file
处理过程中会显示实时速度和预计剩余时间。: Live speed and estimated remaining time are shown while processing.
如果输出文件已存在，是否覆盖: Overwrite output files if they already exist
将上面设置的时间段添加到列表: Add the time range above to the list
将元数据写入到文件的扩展属性中（使用Dublin Core和XDG标准）: Write metadata to file extended attributes (Dublin Core / XDG standards)
将字幕嵌入到视频文件中（需要 ffmpeg）。注意：MP4 对字幕嵌入支持有限，: Embed subtitles into the video file (requires ffmpeg). Note: MP4 has limited support; MKV is more reliable — choose MKV in Advanced Format or enable remuxing to MKV. If the video only has auto subs, also check 'Download auto-generated subtitles'.
将字幕转换为 SRT 格式并使用 UTF-8 编码，确保中文字符正常显示，推荐开: Convert subtitles to SRT with UTF-8 encoding to ensure Chinese characters display correctly (recommended)
将完整的JSON元数据信息嵌入到mkv/mka视频文件中: Embed full JSON metadata into mkv/mka video files
将标题、作者、描述等基础元数据信息嵌入到视频文件中: Embed basic metadata (title, author, description) into the video file
将视频章节信息嵌入到视频文件中（如果可用）: Embed chapter info into the video file (if available)
将视频缩略图嵌入到视频文件中作为封面: Embed the video thumbnail as cover art
已添加的时间段列表，双击可删除: List of added time ranges; double-click to remove
打开内置浏览器：播放网页视频时自动捕获下载地址；登录账号以同步您的播放与下载权限: Open built-in browser: captures download URLs while playing web videos; log in to sync your playback & download permissions.
按内容类型选择修复方案。真人和实拍优先选通用修复，动漫内容选动漫方案。: Choose an enhancement preset by content type: general for live-action/real footage, anime for cartoons.
按当前方案批量开始修复列表中的文件。: Start batch enhancement of the listed files with the current settings.
显示当前修复引擎、模型和可用状态。: Shows the current enhancement engine, model and availability.
显示当前已加入待修复队列的文件数量。: Shows how many files are in the enhancement queue.
显示当前批量任务的整体处理进度。: Shows overall progress of the current batch task.
查看每个文件的开始、完成、失败和详细处理日志。: View start/complete/fail status and detailed logs for each file.
测试代理连接是否正常: Test whether the proxy connection works
测试该IP地址是否可以在本地绑定: Test whether this IP can be bound locally
添加到输出文件名的后缀，留空则使用原文件名: Suffix added to the output filename; leave empty to keep the original name
添加手动输入的时间段/章节规则: Add a manually entered time-range/chapter rule
添加自定义章节到移除列表: Add a custom chapter to the removal list
清空整个待修复列表，不会删除磁盘上的原文件。: Clear the entire enhancement queue (files on disk are not deleted).
点击下方按钮检查官网新版本: Click the button below to check for a new version on the website
点击获取当前URL的播放列表信息（适用于博主主页、频道页面等）: Fetch playlist info for the current URL (works for creator homepages, channel pages, etc.)
画质修复由于包体积精简，首次使用特定模型时会自动从云端高速补全。: To keep the package small, specific enhancement models are auto-downloaded from the cloud on first use.
留空则保存到原文件所在目录: Leave empty to save to the original file's folder
移除当前选中的文件，不会删除原文件。: Remove the selected files from the list (originals are not deleted).
移除赞助商和广告章节（sponsor、ad等）: Remove sponsor and ad chapters (sponsor, ad, etc.)
稳定模式（大图、长视频或报错时更稳，但更慢）: Stable mode (more stable for large images, long videos or errors, but slower)
等待预约直播或计划发布的视频变为可用状态: Wait until a scheduled live stream or video becomes available
绑定到特定的本地IP地址（多网卡环境使用）: Bind to a specific local IP address (for multi-NIC environments)
结束时间-分钟（填0表示到视频结束）: End time - minutes (0 = end of video)
结束时间-小时（填0表示到视频结束）: End time - hours (0 = end of video)
结束时间-秒（填0表示到视频结束）: End time - seconds (0 = end of video)
自动检测并移除 YouTube 视频中的广告、赞助商内容等片段: Automatically detect and remove ads, sponsor segments, etc. from YouTube videos
自动获取可用格式并支持复杂过滤和排序: Fetch available formats automatically with advanced filtering and sorting
自定义输出倍率。大多数情况保留默认即可。: Custom output scale. Default is fine for most cases.
要移除的章节列表，双击可删除: List of chapters to remove; double-click to delete
覆盖同名输出文件: Overwrite output files with the same name
视频下载、转码输出、图片处理共用同一个目录。: Downloads, transcoded output and image processing share one directory.
设置字幕下载之间的延迟时间，避免频繁请求被限制: Delay between subtitle downloads to avoid rate limiting
转码速度预设：快速转码快但质量一般，正常平衡速度和质量，高质量转码慢但质量最佳: Speed preset: Fast is quick with average quality; Normal balances speed and quality; High quality is slow but best
输入要移除的章节名称: Enter the chapter name to remove
输入要绑定的本地网卡IP地址: Enter the local NIC IP address to bind
这里会显示处理进度、每个文件的结果和错误信息。: Processing progress, per-file results and errors are shown here.
这里显示待修复文件。可多选后移除，也可直接拖入新文件。: Files to enhance are listed here. Multi-select to remove, or drag in new files.
适合自拍、证件照、人物特写。动漫方案不会使用这个选项。: Best for selfies, ID photos and close-ups. Not used by the anime preset.
选择下载格式。'最佳质量'选项会自动选择最佳视频和音频质量。'仅缩略图'选项只下: Choose the download format. 'Best Quality' auto-picks the best video and audio. 'Thumbnail Only' downloads just the cover image, not the video.
选择修复场景和输出方式。大多数情况下只需要选场景和倍率。: Choose the enhancement scenario and output method. Usually just pick a scenario and scale.
选择修复结果的保存目录。: Choose where enhanced results are saved.
选择字幕文件格式。支持格式优先级，如'srt/ass/vtt/best'会按优先: Choose the subtitle file format. Priority syntax like 'srt/ass/vtt/best' picks the first available
选择本地图片或视频，加入当前待修复列表。: Pick local images or videos and add them to the enhancement queue.
选择要下载的字幕语言，'全部语言'将下载所有可用语言的字幕: Choose subtitle languages to download; 'All languages' downloads every available one
Select a video file to transcode...
选择软件界面显示的语言，切换后重启软件生效。: Choose the interface language. Restart the app for it to take full effect.
Choose output directory (leave empty to save next to source files)...
选择音频语言。'自动选择'会优先选择英语或视频的默认语言。: Choose audio language. 'Auto' prefers English or the video's default language.
速度信息会在处理开始后显示: Speed info appears after processing starts
遇到下载或后处理错误时继续执行，不中止整个任务（推荐开启）: Continue on download/post-processing errors instead of aborting the whole task (recommended)
遇到大图、长视频、报错或速度不稳定时可开启，处理会更稳但更慢。: Enable for large images, long videos, errors or unstable speed — more stable but slower.
预览视频的所有可用字幕语言和格式（不下载视频）: Preview all available subtitle languages and formats (no download)
高级设置（通常不需要改）: Advanced settings (usually no need to change)
默认会跟随修复场景自动选模型。只有需要精细控制时再手动指定。: Model is auto-picked from the scenario by default. Override manually only for fine control.
默认保持原格式。只有明确需要统一输出格式时再修改。: Keeps the original format by default. Change only when you need a unified output format.
默认提供 2 倍和 4 倍。只有你需要更细的倍率时再开启。: 2x and 4x by default. Enable only if you need finer scales.
默认自动检测即可。程序会按当前机器和模型自动选择更快的视频后端，并缓存上次测得的: Auto-detect is fine. The app picks the faster video backend for your machine/model, caches the best result, and falls back to a more stable option on errors.
